note: Directory basenames the files.list walk never descends into, on top of the universal dot rule (every dot-prefixed entry - .git, .venv, .cache, .pnpm-store, ... - is always skipped). Exact basename match only, no globs. Edit this list to tune what the @-mention picker sees; the walk reads it once at module load. Keep it to caches and build outputs - never to source directories (vendor/, packages/, src/, ...).
